# Meera — AI Chief of Staff

> Meera is an AI Chief of Staff built by Hypotenuse Analytics. She joins meetings, transcribes conversations, extracts action items, tracks follow-ups, and surfaces insights automatically.

## Key facts

- **Product**: AI Chief of Staff for meeting intelligence and team memory
- **Company**: Hypotenuse Analytics
- **Pricing**: Free tier available, Growth at $29/month, Enterprise custom
- **Integrations**: Google Calendar, Google Meet, Slack, Deepgram transcription
- **Capabilities**: Meeting transcription, action item extraction, team memory Q&A, resume automation, weekly digests, follow-up tracking

## Pages

- Home: https://meera.hyzen.tech
- Pricing: https://meera.hyzen.tech/plans

## Tech stack

- Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript 5.9
- Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP 3.15, Lenis 1.1
- Framer Motion, @animateicons/react

## Design system

- Bauhaus-inspired: cream base (#F1EEE4), near-black ink (#16171B), red accent (#D6402C)
- Typography: Syne (display), Archivo (body), JetBrains Mono (data)
- 10-section landing page with scroll animations and bento grids
